authority: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE), Ministry of Power
scope: Shelters with connected electrical load >= 100 kW or contract demand >= 120 kVA

rules.clause: Table 4.1 - Maximum U-Factor for Opaque Walls
rules.description: Composite and Hot-Dry climates mandate opaque exterior wall U-value <= 0.44 W/m²K for mandatory ECBC baseline compliance.
rules.remediation: Utilize AAC blocks with exterior insulation or cavity wall with minimum 50mm Rockwool.

rules.clause: Table 4.2 - Maximum U-Factor for Roof Assembly
rules.description: Roof assemblies in all climate zones except cold must not exceed 0.33 W/m²K for baseline ECBC rating.
rules.remediation: Incorporate continuous 75mm rigid XPS/EPS or 80mm high-density Rockwool insulation beneath roof deck.

rules.description: Maximum allowable Window-to-Wall Ratio without prescriptive dynamic shading or whole-building energy modeling is 40%.
rules.remediation: Reduce glazed area or integrate external shading devices with overhang projection factor >= 0.5.
